title: Payment Card
description: A card's number, expiry and security code: spaced as typed, brand shown and checked, each joining a Field; or a payment provider's hosted fields framed in the same look.

components.PaymentCard: Groups a card's number, expiry and security code so they share the brand the number shows.
components.PaymentCardBrands: The card marks at the end of a number field: all it offers until the number shows its brand, then that brand's alone.
components.PaymentCardCvc: Takes a card's security code, as long as the brand the number shows asks for; or frames a payment provider's hosted code field.
components.PaymentCardExpiry: Takes a card's expiry as MM/YY, adding the slash as it is typed; or frames a payment provider's hosted expiry field.
components.PaymentCardNumber: Takes a card number, spaced as the card prints it, with its brand's logo at the end; or frames a payment provider's hosted number field.
